title: Clicking browser back button jumps back to first page of results
body:
### 🐛 Current behavior

I'm implementing custom routing with Vue router but having an issue with the browser back button jumping back to the first page of results. The issue is seen here in this [sandbox](https://codesandbox.io/p/sandbox/github/algolia/doc-code-samples/tree/master/vue-instantsearch/routing-vue-router)


### 🔍 Steps to reproduce

Click through the pagination to go to a few different pages and then click the browser back button. It doesn't take you back to the previous page of results you were on, it takes you back to the first page.

### Live reproduction

https://codesandbox.io/p/sandbox/github/algolia/doc-code-samples/tree/master/vue-instantsearch/routing-vue-router

### 💭 Expected behavior

I expect to be take back to previous page of results not the first page.

### Package version

"instantsearch.js": "^4.77.3", "vue-instantsearch": "^4.20.4", "algoliasearch": "^5.20.2",

### Operating system

_No response_

_No response_

comments.body: The router looks right, do you have a sandbox with the wrong behaviour?
@Haroenv No, it's just in my local code but I can try to make a sandbox.

@Haroenv Ok I've made a codesandbox if you're please able to take a look, I would greatly appreciate it. For some reason my url isn't updating when I click through the pagination pages though. Locally it works fine.
https://codesandbox.io/p/devbox/jx9xy2?file=%2Fsrc%2FApp.vue%3A16%2C39
You'll need to make the link public first
@Haroenv Sorry about that, should be public now

I'm not really sure what's going on, push in the vue router seems to do nothing at all 🤔 as well as reading not returning anything.

Have you tried just using the history router that comes with InstantSearch? for most cases this should fit and there isn't really a reason to synchronise it with vue router
@Haroenv I did try that when I was first setting up the routing/url synchronization a few months ago but could never get it working correctly until I added the custom routing for vue router.
